description: Turn the content engine on for a brand from an onboarding conversation, or update its settings later. FREE with structured fields. Collect the answers FIRST (use the setup_content_space prompt: brand & site → audience → tone with the archetype options → platforms → post types → 3–8 topics → example posts), read them back to the user for a yes, THEN call this once. Target an existing space with space_id, or create a fresh solo space for the brand with new_space:{name}. First-time setup needs at least `voice` and `platforms`. Topics are appended (≤12 per call; keywords proposed when omitted). Pass `brand_doc` only when the user hands over a written brand template (it costs 5 credits to structure); answers you collected go in the fields for free. Nothing is published by this tool.

brand_doc.description: A filled brand template the user pasted — costs 5 credits to structure.

new_space.description: Create a solo Amplify space for this brand (idempotent on name).

name.description: Brand or product name — becomes the space name.

platform_playbook.description: Per-platform notes, e.g. "X: short and punchy. LinkedIn: longer, more reflective."

platforms.description: Where the brand posts, e.g. ["X", "LinkedIn"]. One draft per platform is written per topic.

post_types.description: The kinds of posts they want (how-tos, build-in-public notes, hot takes, customer wins, thesis drops…).

space_id.description: Existing space to enable/update (one of space_id / new_space is required).

topics.description: The inventory of themes to post about (3–8 to start).

keywords.description: 2–4 broad, short search terms. Omit and the engine proposes them.

label.description: The theme, e.g. 'Why distribution beats building'.

search_context.description: The angle or audience for this theme.

trending_source_handles.description: X accounts to pin for 'Trending on X' (news outlets, analysts, competitors).

voice.description: Voice & style as a tight paragraph: tone in 3–5 words, do's and don'ts, typical length, emoji / hashtag / link policy, words to use and avoid, and the feel of any example posts the user shared.

name: setup_content_space
title: Set up (or update) a brand's content space
